strongest_a: [medium] The report repeatedly states, "We are investigating an issue where customers may experience timeouts, service degradations, errors, and elevated latencies across multiple products in the us-west1 region." However, there is no mention of the root cause of these issues.

[medium] For the Bare Metal Solution incident, the root cause is identified as a "cooling failure," but this level of detail is missing for other incidents (e.g., Vertex AI Gemini API, Apigee Edge Public Cloud, etc.).

[medium] Impact:** Without root-cause evidence, it is difficult to assess whether the issue has been fully resolved or if it could recur. This also limits the ability to implement preventive measures.

[medium] The report does not describe any remediation steps taken to resolve the incidents. For example, it mentions that issues were "investigated" but does not specify what actions were taken to mitigate the problems.

[medium] For the Bare Metal Solution incident, while the root cause is identified, there is no mention of how the cooling failure was addressed or what measures were taken to prevent future occurrences.
